description: The Blood of Dawnwalker's reactive gameplay and story systems work together for a deeply satisfying RPG experience where the game world responds to your decisions and moves forward with their outcomes, whether good or bad. Over the 50 or so hours it will take you to finish the main story, the game’s combat may start showing signs of wear and tear, but its compelling characters, its bleak atmosphere, and its time-bound quest design remain persistently persuasive.
title: The Blood of Dawnwalker Review: Rebel Wolves' Gothic RPG Delights and Disturbs

description: Philips, a consumer electronics company, is set to launch its 5G phone in India soon. The brand has yet to confirm the official moniker, but it has now confirmed the launch date through a microsite on Amazon. The listing also reveals the design and key specifications of the upcoming handset. It is shown in three colour options and has a 64-megapixel AI-assisted rear camera.
title: Philips 5G Smartphone India Launch Date Confirmed: Here’s What We Know

description: The Xiaomi Pad 9 Pro Max has appeared in a Geekbench 6.7.1 listing with the company’s Xring O3 chipset. The tablet recorded 3,474 points in single-core testing and 13,229 points in multi-core testing. The listing also shows 15GB of RAM and Android 17, along with a 10-core processor reaching 4.36GHz. Xiaomi has confirmed a September launch in China, while leaks have suggested a 13.3-inch display, a battery above 10,000mAh and 120W charging support.
title: Xiaomi Pad 9 Pro Max Appears on Geekbench With Xring O3 Chip

description: Boltt has confirmed its 3+4 software support policy for the Ace 5G and Evo smartphones. Both devices will receive three major Android OS upgrades and four years of security updates, with patches arriving at least once every quarter. Critical security fixes can be issued outside the regular schedule when required. The support period starts from each phone’s official launch date. Both models will go on sale through Flipkart from September 1, with Day 1 prices starting at Rs. 12,999 and Rs. 9,999.
title: Boltt Reveals Software Update Policy for Ace 5G and Evo Ahead of September 1 Sale

description: Vivo T5 5G is all set to launch in India on September 2. Just days ahead of the launch, Vivo has confirmed the battery and rear camera details of the upcoming T-series phone. It will have a dual rear camera unit including a 50-megapixel primary Sony IMX882 sensor and an 8-megapixel ultra-wide-angle secondary sensor. The Vivo T5 will feature a 32-megapixel front-facing camera.
title: Vivo T5 5G Key Specifications Teased; 7,050mAh Battery, Dual Rear Cameras Confirmed

description: PhonePe has introduced UPI 123Pay for feature phones, allowing users to make digital payments without an internet connection. The SMS-based service supports transfers through mobile numbers and UPI IDs, along with QR payments on compatible camera-equipped phones. It also offers bank balance and transaction history features, while bill payments, recharges and Aadhaar-based registration are planned. The service is currently available on selected HMD, Nokia, Lava and Itel feature phones, with PhonePe set to add support for more models.
title: PhonePe UPI 123Pay Enables UPI Payments Without Internet on Feature Phones in India

description: The National Payments Corporation of India will announce new functionalities for UPI during the Global Fintech Fest 2026, which is set to take place at the Jio World Centre in Mumbai between September 8 and 11, according to a report. The organisation is said to soon start allowing users to port UPI autopay mandates from one digital payments platform to another. This would eliminate the need for users to cancel their mandates from one app to shift to a different platform of their choice, whether it is for OTT subscriptions, SIP instalments, insurance premiums, or EMIs. On top of this, NPCI will reportedly also announce a new functionality that will enable merchants to shift their existing mandates from one payments gateway service provider to another based on their choice.
title: NPCI to Soon Allow Users to Port UPI AutoPay Mandates Across Digital Payments Platforms: Report

description: Samsung Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra could launch soon. Ahead of the formal launch, the tablet has allegedly been spotted in the Geekbench database with the model number SM-X940. The new listing suggests that the tablet will ship with a MediaTek Dimensity chipset, 12GB of RAM and Android 17. The tablet got 2,760 points in single-core testing and 9,291 points in multi-core testing.
title: Samsung Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra Allegedly Listed on Geekbench With MediaTek Dimensity 9500 Chipset

description: Samsung Galaxy S26 FE will go on sale in India soon via Amazon, Flipkart, and the Samsung online store. The phone will be offered in Blueberry, Graphite, and Pistachio colour options. In India, the Samsung Galaxy S26 FE will arrive with a 6.7-inch Full-HD+ Dynamic AMOLED 2X Display, delivering up to a 120Hz refresh rate, up to 1,900 nits peak brightness, and Corning Gorilla Glass Victus+ protection. The Galaxy S26 FE will be powered by an Exynos 2500 SoC, which is claimed to deliver up to 51 percent faster AI performance, 24 percent improved GPU performance, and 11 percent faster processing.
title: Samsung Galaxy S26 FE Set to Go on Sale in India Soon as Multiple Microsites Go Live

description: OpenClaw has released the as the biggest update to the self-hosted open-source AI agent platform since its launch. As per the company, the update was developed by 933 contributors and includes more than 16,000 pull requests. Dubbed OpenClaw 2.0, it brings changes across installation, messaging, memory, skills, models, automations, browser and native apps, plugins and security. OpenClaw has rebuilt its browser app as a first-class experience, while the initial setup process for new users has been simplified, too.
title: OpenClaw 2.0 Released as Biggest Update Since Launch; Brings Shared Cloud Sessions, Smarter Automations

description: Anthropic researchers have tested Claude as an automated alignment researcher, allowing it to develop and evaluate methods for addressing 10 types of AI safety failures. Claude closed up to 96 percent of the measured safety gap and achieved an average of 85 percent on deception tests. The researchers also used the weaker Claude Sonnet 5 to improve alignment in an early Opus 4.8 model. The results suggest AI could eventually handle more parts of AI research, although the experiment falls short of true self-improvement.
title: Anthropic’s Claude Closes 85 Percent of AI Safety Gap in Automated Research Test

description: Krafton India recently celebrated the 5th Anniversary Edition 4.5 Update of Battlegrounds Mobile India (BGMI). To commemorate the hugely popular online battle royale game, the developer has been frequently releasing BGMI redeem codes in recent weeks. The latest batch, which contains 50 codes in total, gives players a chance to claims limited-time in-game rewards. Each code has a limited redemption capacity and is available on a first-come, first-served basis.
title: BGMI Redeem Codes for August 31: How to Claim Dracostride Skin for UZI, Other Free Rewards

description: Details about Xiaomi’s Pad 9 Pro have leaked, revealing key hardware details about the upcoming tablet. According to a tipster on Weibo, the tablet will feature a 12.5-inch display and a Qualcomm processor instead of Xiaomi’s Xring O3 processor, which is said to debut on upcoming products launching in early September.
title: Xiaomi Pad 9 Pro Could Get a Huge 11,000mAh Battery and Bigger 12.5-Inch Display, Leak Suggests

description: Sony Music and Warner Chappell have filed a lawsuit against Anthropic. The Claude maker allegedly used copyrighted material without permission. Anthropic co-founders Dario Amodei and Benjamin Mann are named as individual defendants. The complaint alleges that Mann used BitTorrent to download many pirated books, and Anthropic employees allegedly downloaded at least two million more books from the Pirate Library Mirror. Sony Music Publishing and Warner Chappell Music are demanding that all infringing copies of the works be destroyed and that Anthropic supply an account of Claude‘s training data.
title: Anthropic Faces Lawsuit From Sony Music, Warner Chappell Over Alleged Copyrighted Material Use

description: WhatsApp is reportedly rolling out the Scam Alert feature to a limited number of Android beta testers with version 2.26.34.1. This functionality runs an on-device machine learning model to alert users about potential scam messages. It is an optional feature, and when the model identifies a message as a likely scam attempt, the user sees a warning in the chat, which is not visible to the other person.
title: WhatsApp's Scam Alert Feature Arrives for Android Beta Users: Report

description: Apple’s rumoured first foldable iPhone could bring a repair bill of around $1,155 (roughly Rs. 1,10,200) for its inner display, according to an estimate from repair specialist Ricky Panesar. The projected cost is higher than reported screen replacement charges for Samsung’s Galaxy Z Fold 8 and Galaxy Z Fold 7. The handset is also expected to cost around $2,000 (roughly Rs. 1,90,900), and could debut on September 9, although sales may begin in October
title: Apple’s Foldable iPhone Could Be Expensive to Repair, With Screen Cost Tipped at Over $1,000

description: Xiaomi’s yet-to-be-announced foldable, the 18 Fold, is tipped to pack a 6,000mAh battery. If the information is genuine, it will be Xiaomi’s biggest battery in a foldable to date. According to the source, the device will also feature fast wired and wireless charging. The upcoming foldable is also said to debut Xiaomi’s Xring O3 chipset.
title: Xiaomi 18 Fold Battery and Charging Details Leaked Ahead of Launch: What You Need to Know

description: Apple is unlikely to launch a dedicated Apple Pencil for the iPhone Ultra, Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman writes in the latest edition of his weekly newsletter ‘Power On’. He also highlighted that the company might not abandon Steve Jobs’ position that “Nobody wants a stylus”. According to the report, Apple was earlier considering launching the accessory for its first book-style foldable. The tech giant also reportedly prototyped and tested the special Apple Pencil for the iPhone Ultra. The prototype of the stylus is said to be shorter and thicker than the one sold for iPad models to better fit the foldable’s passport-like form factor.
title: iPhone Ultra May Launch Without an Apple Pencil, New Report Claims

description: Ather Energy expanded its range of electric scooters with the launch of the Ather Konarc on electric scooter at its fourth annual Community Day in India on Saturday. The latest vehicle from the Bengaluru-based EV manufacturer marks the debut of the new EL platform. Ather has positioned Konarc as a practical, everyday electric scooter with a claimed Indian Driving Cycle (IDC) range of up to 161km. It also offers technology-focussed features like MagicKey, AutoHold and Park Assist,
title: Ather Konarc Launched in India With Up to 200km IDC Range, AEBS Braking and MagicKey: Price, Features

description: Google Pixel 11, Pixel 11 Pro, Pixel 11 Pro XL, and Pixel 11 Pro Fold do not support the ARM Memory Tagging Extension (MTE) security feature, the GarpheneOS Foundation said in a social media post. Hence, the company was unable to complete the port for its OS for the Google Pixel 11 series. However, it did manage to build only a partial port of GrapheneOS for the Google Pixel 11 series after a week’s work. The foundation said that Google is not offering MTE support in software, firmware, and “near certainly hardware” of the Pixel 11 series “to save money”.
title: Google Pixel 11 Series Will Not Get GrapheneOS as Google Skips a Major Security Feature

description: Motorola has teased a new Razr-style foldable developed with Swarovski, showing a black rear panel with a patterned finish and crystal detailing. The company has not confirmed the handset’s name, but reports suggest it could be linked to the Razr 70. Expected specifications include a 6.9-inch OLED display, 4,500mAh battery and dual 50-megapixel rear cameras. The phone could also include a transparent case and 33W charger. Motorola is expected to reveal more at IFA 2026 in September.
title: Motorola Teases New Razr Foldable With Swarovski Crystal Design Ahead of IFA

description: Huawei Watch D3 is all set to launch later this week in global markets. The new smartwatch will be launched alongside the Huawei FreeBuds Neo TWS earphones. The tech giant has dropped the first teaser of the smartwatch and earphones, showing what they look like. The company has also previewed the Huawei Watch D3 at the European Society of Cardiology Congress (ESC Congress 2026).
title: Huawei Watch D3, FreeBuds Neo Launch Date Announced; Design, Key Specifications Teased

description: Redmi 17 5G will be launched in India on September 3, the company has revealed. A dedicated microsite for the Redmi 17 5G is now live, revealing that the handset will be available for purchase in the country via Amazon in three colour options, namely Absolutely Black, Endless Blue, and Eternal Orange. The Indian version of the Redmi 17 5G is identical to its global counterpart in terms of design. It will be powered by an octa-core Snapdragon 4 Gen 5 chipset from Qualcomm. On top of this, the smartphone will be equipped with a 7,900mAh battery.
title: Redmi 17 5G India Launch Date Announced; Will Debut With a Larger Battery Than the Global Model

description: The Poco F9 is set to launch soon in the global marketers as the company’s next-generation performance-focussed lineup, comprising the Poco F9 Pro and F9 Ultra. Both models expected to be based on the Redmi K100 series smartphones sold in China. With just a day to go till their debut, pricing of the Poco F9 series has been leaked by a tipster. The Ultra model is believed to be twice as expensive as the F9 Pro in select regions.
title: Poco F9 Ultra May Cost Nearly Twice as Much as Poco F9 Pro, Tipster Claims

description: With less than two weeks to go for Apple’s ‘Surprise and shine’ event, rumours about the tech giant’s next-generation hardware are now surfacing rapidly. While most of the focus seems to be on the iPhone 18 series, particularly the iPhone Ultra, a new report suggests that Apple could also be preparing a significant health-focused update for its next-generation smartwatch. Apple Watch Series 12 and Watch Ultra 4 are said to introduce two new features to provide users with more continuous health data.
title: Apple Watch Series 12, Ultra 4 Could Get Two Major Health Upgrades, New Finishes: Report
